capture.zh: 在拜伦号（幽灵飞船）挑战尤纳斯，打败获得尤纳斯精元（孵化得影球）；最后一滴血只能用「幻影」打掉。

strategy_notes.zh: 暗影屏障：被布鲁克克的贯穿水枪打中之前，攻击对它都是0伤害，寄生照样有效。布布花/依卡莱恩寄生种子+吃药硬撑，强化防御后一直寄生把它吸到1滴血；再用布鲁克克的贯穿水枪打破屏障，最后换速度130以上的神鹿（里奥斯）用幻影收尾。注意黑暗之核加特攻后的黑暗之门。

engine_notes: hp_floor_until {skill 10100 幻影}: damage from anything else (including 寄生 drain) cannot take it below 1 HP; only a hit by 幻影 (普通系 physical, learnt by 里奥斯/神鹿) can remove the last HP.

barrier_until_skill {skill 10323 贯穿水枪} (暗影屏障): 4399 2010-05-26 (69566) '尤纳斯普通攻击打他都0滴血，只能用异常状态打倒他或用布鲁克克的贯穿水枪打破他的暗影屏障，之后才能攻击'; 4399 70397 '布鲁贯穿水枪的可以使打BOSS不会0伤害'; 4399 2009-11-23 '物攻或特攻等攻击性技能对它无效'. Until 贯穿水枪 (布鲁克克) hits it, the foe's attacks deal 0: attack damage and the fixed or percentage damage of physical or special skills (the 2009-11 wording names 物攻或特攻等攻击性技能). 寄生 and other status damage, which carry no skill, still work. 幻影 is an attack too, so the last HP needs the barrier broken first. The 2009-10-30 release, where attacks never worked, is not used.

Barrier details the sources leave open, simplest reading: the breaking hit of 贯穿水枪 deals its normal damage (as the 幻影 hit does under hp_floor_until); any monster's 贯穿水枪 breaks it, not only 布鲁克克's; once broken it stays broken for the battle; damage without a skill (DoT ticks, reflection) is not an attack. '只能用异常状态打倒他' is read together with hp_floor_until, which still reserves the last HP for 幻影.

Status: 4399 (2010-06): 'BOSS不再受冻伤、中毒等异常状态影响' (a patch removed DoT cheese), yet 寄生种子 is still the core strategy in every 2010-2011 guide, so leech is NOT in the immunity list. Burn assumed immune with poison/freeze.
unlimited_pp_skill: 黑暗之门 (无限次数) never runs out of PP; its other skills have normal PP.
HP: 2800 (4399 2010, 7k7k 2011, 4399 问答 2011). The 怀旧服 6000 HP / 攻击+2 version is the 2013 S-mode rework, not used.
skills: all four are named by period guides (4399 2010-06-01 and 2010-06-05, 7k7k 2011-03-16) and equal species 132's last four at or below Lv70 (黑暗之门 at Lv70 is included).
reward: 精元 item (kind essence) hatching the base form of the line at Lv1, as the original 分子转化器 did (e.g. 里奥斯精元 → 胡里亚, 阿克希亚精元 → 索拉, 斯普林特精元 → 斯林德).
source_note: 4399 BOSS series (2010-06-05): 70级 血量2800, 黑暗之门（无限次数）, 最后一滴血只能通过幻影打掉, 不受冻伤、中毒影响.
